name: ip-visual-forge
description: Character IP visual director: turns a photo, a plush toy, an existing mascot, or a single line of persona into a reusable personal-IP character, then keeps that same character recognizable across articles, scenes, and platforms. Routes across seven bundled IP skills (character onboarding / from-scratch design / avatar-and-logo mark / photo-to-article illustrations / long-term cross-platform reuse / character-driven knowledge diagrams / whole-article editorial visual system), locks one identity anchor plus one visual spec before any generation, and runs a consistency gate on every image.

displayDescription.en: Builds one reusable character from a photo or a single line of persona, then keeps it recognizable across every article, scene and platform.
displayDescription.zh: 从一张照片或一句人设开始，建立可复用角色档案，再按文章、场景或平台产出风格统一的配图与图解。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I only have a selfie — build me a reusable character for article illustrations
